title: Completion requirements and evidence
guidance: Keep the overall task composition. Strengthen the minimal met-requirement signal and distinguish section headings from item headings. Refine empty-evidence spacing.

decisions.title: Section titles and item headings are distinct
decisions.reason: Section heading1.125rem, item weight/size subordinate, empty-state title1rem normal weight. Remove explanations that simply repeat met conditions.

decisions.title: Checks remain minimal but visible
decisions.reason: Met checks use the semantic success ink,1.25em size and2.2 stroke. Keep meaningful missing-proof/payment/offer explanations.

decisions.title: Evidence uses the shared attachment/link pattern
decisions.reason: Proof tag, destination and date remain distinct. The empty state retains the important rule that Brief/Other do not replace Proof.

decisions.title: Name unmet conditions without asserting the current state
decisions.reason: In Progress status is a requirement label; an Accepted entity must not appear to assert that work is already In Progress. Actual lifecycle badge remains canonical.

parameters.name: Checklist/evidence
parameters.description: Task grid separates requirements and evidence; narrow enlarged empty evidence stacks its icon above copy.

status.human: feedback received; current revision awaits review
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment
